firmware.releaseNotes: A new source-matched GCC test target for validating the standalone Check Update feature with App 1.0.85 background connection recovery. Preserve the existing four-character Chinese menu, established firmware dialog style, E-Track advertising name, companion protocol, BLE UUID/address/baud and V2 transport. No new wire command, key, layout or boot gate. Installation still requires explicit device consent, no open recording, sufficient battery or charging, integrity checks and post-reboot identity verification. Original Admin candidate only: the operator chooses channel publication and an exact 3.3.35-to-3.3.36 delta if needed.
